BPR not strictly required for boiling point but recommended to maintain pressure for gas sparging and prevent solvent evaporation if heated later.

batch_record.reaction_description: Dioxygenation of an alkene using PhI(OAc)2 and a tridentate palladium complex immobilized on magnetic particles.
batch_record.raw_text: An alkene (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv), PhI(OAc)2 (1.2 equiv), and a tridentate palladium complex immobilized on magnetic particles (3.5 mol%) were combined in DMF/AcOH (1:2) under nitrogen. The mixture was stirred at 20 C for 5 h to give the dioxygenated alkene in 86% yield.
